ninfea.source: scores of the healthy NInFEA recordings with a readable ECG (run wp6_fusion)

published.source: out-of-fold scores of the normal NIFEADB recordings (run wp4b_rhythm_intervals)

dataset: NIFEADB (PhysioNet, ODC-By 1.0): 12 arrhythmia and 14 normal-rhythm recordings
intended_input: WFDB record (.hea and .dat) in the NInFEA layout (24 abdominal channels uni_abd1-24, thoracic leads bi_tho1-3; whole record, as run wp3) or the NIFEADB layout (channel ECG from the chest, then Abdomen_1...; 60-second segments, as run wp4a)
known_limits: fitted on 26 NIFEADB recordings of one dataset (12 arrhythmia, 14 normal); later gestation than NInFEA
calibrated on NIFEADB, it referred 51.7% of 60 healthy NInFEA recordings; calibrated on healthy NInFEA recordings of other women, 10.0% (run wp6_fusion)
with 14 healthy calibration recordings the smallest possible p-value is 0.067; the alarm level 0.1 acts as that value
the four 500 Hz NIFEADB recordings are all arrhythmia; on the 1 kHz recordings its AUROC is 0.696 [0.347, 0.981] (run wp9_checks_after_results)

model.name: logistic regression on fetal interval features (sfr.rhythm.evaluate.logistic)
